audit.why: 54.06% Emerald+ over 677 games supports Vex-favoured chart rows.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4] and spikes[1] claim Shadow Surge (R) interrupts Pop Blossom — Vex R deals damage with no CC, and her Doom fear empowers her next BASIC ability only (Q/W/E), never the R. spikes[2] invents a 'passive dash reset' for Neeko, who has no dash outside her R leap. whys[0]/early call Vex's poke 'point-click' — Q is a skillshot.
audit.why: Riot text: Vex passive empowers 'her next basic Ability'; Neeko kit has no dash flag outside R.
audit.corrected: Fear (empowered basic ability) interrupts the Pop Blossom prep; R only finishes. Fabricated dash removed; poke wording fixed.

audit.why: Lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT; kit has E 12-10s, R 120/105/90, W clone 16-12s.
audit.corrected: Numbers and a wait-for-E-before-stepping-up cue added.

notes: Fixed the R-interrupts-Pop-Blossom fabrication: Vex's Doom fear rides her next BASIC ability only, so the interrupt tool is a feared Q/W/E during the leap prep, never Shadow Surge itself. Removed invented 'passive dash reset' for Neeko. Flipped all seven phases[N].side from blanket 'Skill' to Vex (side-only: win[0..6], packet chart and whys all already say Vex). Report cap of two spent on report[0]/report[3]; lint also flagged report[4], report[11], report[13] for his->her swaps — left for follow-up. Whether Pop Blossom's prep is interruptible by fear specifically was cross-checked against Riot's text ('after a short preparation... the preparation is hidden if disguised') — the interruptibility itself is standard channel behaviour per the kit's absence of an unstoppable flag; flagged as Medium-confidence in unverified.
